context_requirements: Bacterial cell wall synthesis machinery (penicillin-binding proteins) must be present; human cells lack PBPs and peptidoglycan biosynthesis
For any indirect effect, drug must engage one of the annotated human off-targets (CYP2C19, SLC15A1, SLC15A2, SLC22A6) at 10 micromolar
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine human cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is not explained by vehicle or general toxicity
Evidence of PBP-like target engagement or peptidoglycan-pathway gene expression changes in human cells
